item.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day — Sat Aug 22, 11:15 AM — The Bellevue
item.description:
Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

item.title: Spa Weekend — Sat Aug 22, 12:15 PM — The Clairidge
item.description:
Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves—and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.
Source: Montclair Film

item.title: Assemblage Lab & Gallery Talk — Unrecyclable: Look Again — Sat Aug 22, 1:00 PM — The Space
item.description:
Close out Unrecyclable: Look Again with a gallery talk by artist Andrew Borg, followed by a hands-on Assemblage Lab. Borg walks the exhibition and tells the story behind the work, then participants build assemblages of their own from unrecyclable plastics and metals, worn tools, and “ghost objects” — broken or outmoded technology. Materials provided; bring your own discards too, the stranger the better. No prior experience required. $10. Register in advance or at the door. item.title: The Assembly of Lovers - Sufi Drum Circle — Mon Aug 31, 7:00 PM — the Space
item.description: Community drum and chant circle rooted in Sufi prayer. Contribution: Sliding scale donation $20–$40 (no one will be turned away) This is a vibrant Community Drum and Chanting Circle, where we drum and chant from our hearts into the universe. This experience is open to absolutely everyone, regardless of background or belief system—all that’s required is an open heart and a willingness to connect through sound. The term ‘lover’ in this context refers to seekers on the Sufi path who are longing for union with the divine energy. You can think of this gathering as an expansion of the sema sufi meditations we used to offer. It is looser in form, more focused on music, and does not necessarily involve whirling, although it is welcome if you are called to it. There is a rhythm older than thought. A pulse that moves beneath language, beneath belief, beneath the self that thinks it’s separate. The Mystics knew this. The Sufis practiced it in Majalis al-‘Ushshāq. The Assembly of Lovers. Not

item.title: Tuesday Night Figure Drawing - Open Studio — Tue Sep 1, 7:00 PM — the Space
item.description:
Tuesday Night Figure Drawing – Open Studio *Cover art by Ling Chen.
Tuesday night at The Space is your invitation to drop in, find your creative flow, and feel good. Each week a different nude model serves as our muse as we pursue creative expression through observation and mark making. We challenge how we see and what we want to say — observing the nuances of the human form, its moods, character, and light — and do our best to capture something in the moment that tells a story. This has become a tight-knit, supportive community of seekers — artists, experimenters, and curious souls drawn together by the shared pursuit of capturing the living human form. Use the time to refine your skills, experiment with different media, and deepen your understanding of anatomy, gesture, and proportion. item.title: Mindful Masculinity Men’s Group — Wed Sep 2, 7:00 PM — The Space
item.description:
We Meet Bi-Weekly Every Other Wednesday | 7 – 8:30 pm | $15
Through open dialogue, mindfulness, and other calming practices we quiet the mind, open the heart, and deepen our connection to ourselves and each other. The meetings are hosted by Leo, mindfulness coach, teacher, and dad. We start by sharing our wins and challenges, honoring each voice without judgment or advice. We dive into practices that help us release stress, shift perspectives, and bring awareness and resilience into our lives. Each week, we focus on a different topic to help guide our lives. Together, we explore themes of trust, accomplishments, family, rest, intimacy, and presence — discovering new ways to move through the world as mindful men. Come as you are. Leave more grounded, connected, and inspired. Connect with Leo: Instagram @holdingpresence Online: HoldingPresence.com E-Mail: pe***********@***il.com
Source: The Space For Art

Whether you’re a seasoned author or just getting started, this is your chance to share your work in front of a supportive and inspiring audience. Bring your poetry, short stories, or excerpts from your latest work — the stage is yours! The Space is a safe place to try out new material, read old favorites, experiment with a different genre, and even to sing a song if inspiration strikes you. item.title: Memory Café - A Dementia-Friendly Social Gathering — Mon Oct 12, 11:30 AM — Montclair Main - Auditorium
item.description:
For adults with dementia and their caregivers, this event offers a welcoming, safe, calming space for socializing, music, art and reminiscing every month.
A “Memory Café” is a dementia-friendly social gathering for individuals with early-stage memory loss or mild cognitive decline and their care givers.
The meetings will be held in a safe and comfortable environment where people can interact and socialize with others having similar experiences. At the gatherings participants can get support in a non-judgmental setting, while enjoying the benefits of music for the brain.
The meetings will be run by Lisy Espindola, LCSW and Kim McLennon, MSW and music therapist. Lunch and/or snacks will be served.
This is a joint program between Lifelong Montclair at the Township of Montclair and the Montclair Public Library.
Attendance is free but registration is required. Questions? Call 973-744-3278.
